threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'thank you' to the bus driver when you get off. Everyone else just hops off like it's a personal affront.
Last night on the N133, a guy sang the entire 'Bohemian Rhapsody' and somehow got the whole bus to join in. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw my neighbor fixing an old bike with one hand while holding a baby in the other—now that's Berlin grit.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find an open-air cinema showing cult classics next to a park where locals bring their own drinks and chairs. Pure summer vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone's a true local if they’ve seen the BART Civic Center station evacuated and shrugged it off like it's just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 47 express dressed in a full suit, balancing a performance ukulele like it was a baby. Only in the Tenderloin, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí spots. They miss the quiet corners where locals have coffee and gossip about last night's concert.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their bewilderment at the 'no smoking' signs in parks—still getting used to the city’s unwritten rules.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus with the distinctive 'Not in Service' display is just an oddity instead of a normal sight.
Last night on the 47, a guy serenaded the whole bus with 'Wonderwall'—he's got potential but the crowd were not having it. Classic Bermondsey vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a mom juggle a toddler and a shopping cart while exchanging jokes with a street musician outside Rewe. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find an entire park filled with workout stations while grunge bands play nearby. The vibe is uniquely chaotic yet harmonious.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local will know to avoid BART after a game night—those late-night express trains are a gamble, and delays aren't a surprise.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a N bus last night, packed with Giants fans. Some guy tried to rally everyone for a sing-along, but only two joined in. Classic SF vibe.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just for Gaudí and bars, but it's the local shops and the quiet plazas where the real vibe lives.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still stare at the metro map like it's a treasure map. Locals just hop on and off without a second glance.
